title: Electricity Bill Calculator
description: Estimate your monthly electricity bill from kWh used, your rate per kWh, fixed charges and tax.
howto: Enter the kWh shown on your last meter reading or bill.
Add your per-kWh rate, the fixed monthly charge and any tax.
Read the full bill breakdown instantly.

faqs.q: Where do I find my per-kWh rate?
faqs.a: It is printed on your electricity bill as the energy charge, usually something like $0.12/kWh. Time-of-use plans have different rates for peak and off-peak.
A flat monthly fee your utility adds regardless of usage, often labeled "service charge" or "supply charge".

faqs.q: Why is my estimate lower than the real bill?
faqs.a: Tiered rates, demand charges, fuel surcharges and time-of-use pricing are not modeled here. This gives a flat-rate estimate.
